key_insight: MatterChat is a multimodal LLM framework that directly fuses material structural data with language models to deliver high‑precision property predictions along with interpretable reasoning, accelerating materials discovery.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between symbolic/structural materials data and language-centric AI: enabling accurate property prediction and human-readable explanations from heterogeneous inputs (structures + text).
method: Multimodal fusion: encode material structural representations (e.g., crystal/atomic structures) alongside textual descriptions into a unified model input for an LLM backbone.
Task‑specific heads: fine‑tune the LLM for quantitative property prediction while retaining generative/explanatory abilities for interpretable reasoning.
Interpretable reasoning pipeline: generate human‑readable chains of evidence linking structural features to predicted properties to support materials design decisions.
impact: Provides a template for building domain-aware multimodal LLMs that produce both accurate quantitative outputs and transparent explanations, enabling AI/ML practitioners to deploy models that are useful for scientific discovery and experimental planning.
